# YouTube
> Global video platform for watching, sharing, creating, and managing video, music, live streams, and communities.

YouTube serves viewers, creators, advertisers, developers, and rightsholders through consumer products, creator education, policy documentation, copyright tools, and official support resources.

## Core Platform
- [YouTube Home](https://www.youtube.com/): Main video platform for watching, searching, uploading, and engaging with channels and communities.
- [YouTube Creators](https://www.youtube.com/creators/): Official creator hub with education, inspiration, product updates, and monetization resources.
- [How YouTube Works](https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/): Explains YouTube’s mission, systems, policies, and platform operations.
- [YouTube Official Blog](https://blog.youtube/): Official news, product announcements, creator stories, and company updates.
- [YouTube Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/): Central help center for viewers, creators, and account support topics.
- [YouTube Studio](https://studio.youtube.com/): Creator dashboard for channel management, analytics, content, and monetization.

## Creator Education
- [Creator Academy](https://creatoracademy.youtube.com/): Structured lessons and courses for growing channels and improving content strategy.
- [YouTube Creators Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@YouTubeCreators): Official channel sharing creator tips, product news, and best practices.
- [YouTube Creators - Getting Started](https://www.youtube.com/creators/how-things-work-on-youtube/): Introductory guidance on publishing, growth, and creator fundamentals.
- [YouTube Creators - Channel Growth](https://www.youtube.com/creators/grow-your-channel/): Resources for audience development, discovery, and channel optimization.
- [YouTube Creators - Monetization](https://www.youtube.com/creators/how-things-work-on-youtube/monetization/): Overview of monetization options, eligibility, and revenue features for creators.
- [YouTube Creators - Shorts](https://www.youtube.com/creators/shorts/): Guidance and inspiration for creating and growing with YouTube Shorts.

## Policies and Safety
- [YouTube Policies](https://www.youtube.com/about/policies/): Central hub for Community Guidelines, safety policies, and enforcement information.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/policies/community-guidelines/): Rules governing harmful, deceptive, graphic, and abusive content on YouTube.
- [YouTube Terms of Service](https://www.youtube.com/t/terms): Legal terms governing use of YouTube products and services.
- [YouTube Privacy Policy](https://www.youtube.com/t/privacy): Privacy information for data collection, use, and user controls.
- [YouTube Safety Center](https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/our-commitments/safeguarding-our-community/): Overview of YouTube’s safety commitments, protections, and responsible platform practices.
- [Transparency Report](https://transparencyreport.google.com/youtube-policy/removals): Public reporting on policy enforcement, removals, and government requests.

## Copyright and Rights Management
- [Copyright on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/about/copyright/): Overview of copyright rules, takedowns, disputes, and protection tools.
- [Copyright Center Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/2676339): Help articles covering claims, strikes, fair use, and copyright processes.
- [Content ID Overview](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2797370): Explains YouTube’s automated copyright matching and rights management system.
- [Copyright Match Tool](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/7648743): Tool for identifying potential reuploads of original creator content.
- [Submit a Copyright Takedown Request](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2807622): Process for requesting removal of allegedly infringing content.
- [How YouTube Works - Copyright](https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/policies/copyright/): High-level explanation of copyright systems and rightsholder protections.

## Monetization and Partner Program
- [YouTube Partner Program Overview](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/72851): Eligibility, application, and monetization basics for the partner program.
- [Monetize with the YouTube Partner Program](https://www.youtube.com/creators/how-things-work-on-youtube/monetization/): Official creator-facing overview of revenue opportunities and requirements.
- [Channel Memberships Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/7636690): Guidance on offering paid memberships and member perks.
- [Super Chat and Super Thanks Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9272056): Help resources for fan funding features during videos and live streams.
- [YouTube Shopping](https://www.youtube.com/creators/shopping/): Creator resources for product tagging, storefronts, and commerce features.
- [YouTube Premium Revenue for Creators](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/7060016): Explains how creators earn from YouTube Premium watch time.

## Product Features
- [YouTube Shorts](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/): Short-form vertical video experience for discovery, creation, and engagement.
- [YouTube Live](https://www.youtube.com/live): Live streaming destination for events, gaming, music, and creator broadcasts.
- [YouTube Music](https://music.youtube.com/): Music streaming product for songs, albums, playlists, and personalized listening.
- [YouTube TV](https://tv.youtube.com/): Live TV streaming service with sports, news, and entertainment channels.
- [YouTube Kids](https://www.youtubekids.com/): Family-focused video experience designed for children and parental controls.
- [YouTube Premium](https://www.youtube.com/premium): Subscription offering ad-free viewing, downloads, and background play.

## Support and Account Help
- [YouTube Help Center](https://support.google.com/youtube/): Main support portal for account, playback, billing, and creator issues.
- [YouTube Studio Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9257498): Help documentation for channel management, uploads, analytics, and settings.
- [YouTube Account Troubleshooting](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9257109): Support for sign-in, channel access, and account recovery problems.
- [YouTube Premium and Paid Memberships Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9153641): Billing and subscription support for Premium and other paid services.
- [Contact Us](https://www.youtube.com/t/contact_us): Official contact and support entry points for YouTube users.
- [Send Feedback](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/4347644): Instructions for reporting bugs and submitting product feedback.

## Developers and APIs
- [YouTube for Developers](https://developers.google.com/youtube): Developer portal for YouTube APIs, tools, and implementation guides.
- [YouTube Data API Overview](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3): Reference and guides for accessing YouTube data programmatically.
- [YouTube IFrame Player API](https://developers.google.com/youtube/iframe_api_reference): API for embedding and controlling YouTube players on websites.
- [YouTube Live Streaming API](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/live): API documentation for managing live broadcasts and streams.
- [YouTube API Reference](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs): Detailed reference for resources, methods, and request parameters.
- [Google API Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/youtube.googleapis.com): Enable and manage YouTube API access within Google Cloud projects.

## News and Company Information
- [YouTube Blog](https://blog.youtube/): Official source for product launches, creator news, and company announcements.
- [Press](https://www.youtube.com/about/press/): Press resources, media contacts, and official company information.
- [About YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/about/): Company overview, values, and links to major YouTube resources.
- [How YouTube Works - Our Commitments](https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/our-commitments/): Explains YouTube’s commitments around responsibility, transparency, and creator opportunity.
- [YouTube Culture and Trends](https://blog.youtube/culture-and-trends/): Editorial coverage of trends, fandom, and cultural moments on YouTube.
- [YouTube Official Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@YouTube): Official channel featuring platform highlights and announcements.
